export const meta = {
  name: 'hail-b2-round5',
  description: 'B2 round five: the four recheck4 leftovers (town page overflow at 288 and 320 px, the measured figures into the docs placeholders, the cancellation-only group figure, one docstring) by three fixers in parallel',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fix', detail: 'site CSS break point; docs figures; joins docstring' }],
}
const WT = '/home/user/wt/wt-b2'
const BRIEF = '/home/user/wt/briefs/hail-b2-brief.md'
const OUT = '/home/user/hail-b2/out2'
const VENV = '/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python'
const COMMON = `You work in the git worktree ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2). Read the last section of ${BRIEF} ("Supervisor decisions after round 4 (D33) and the round-5 list") first; it is your task list. Repository rules (AGENTS.md is in your context): Python first, evidence honesty, plain wording in sentence case, no em-dashes, no model, AI-vendor or AI-product names in repository files, tokens not hex values in CSS, tests with every behaviour change. Other fixers edit other files in this worktree now: edit only the files you own, never run git checkout, stash, reset, add, commit or push, never reformat a file you do not own, and never delete anything outside a folder you created under ${OUT}/<your-name>/. A python with numpy and pyarrow is ${VENV}; the real store tar is ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz. Return a plain report: what you changed (file and line), the commands you ran with their tails, and anything not done.`
const SITE = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the site fixer; you own website/static/style.css, website/templates/town.html, website/templates/map.html, website/static/map/map.css and tests/test_site.py. Round-5 item 1: build the real site from a copy of the worktree (cp -r without .git into ${OUT}/r5-site/src; ${VENV} -m website.build --out ${OUT}/r5-site/real --hail-history --sample --hail-store ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz) and run PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium ${VENV} tools/smoke_pages.py on it to reproduce the failure (town/glendive.html and town/sidney.html wider than 288 and 320 px screens; the zones section's fire lead paragraph has no break point). Find the exact unbreakable token in the built page (quote it), then fix it in the smallest honest way: a CSS rule on the join sections of the town page and the sheet that allows a break inside a long token (overflow-wrap: anywhere, or word-break on that element class), using the existing classes; the words themselves do not change. Rebuild and run tools/smoke_pages.py again (must exit 0 at 288, 320, 375, 768 and 1440 px, light and dark) and PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium ${VENV} tools/smoke_map.py on the same build (must still pass); run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_site (tail). Add or adjust a test only if one asserts the CSS. Report the token, the rule, and the smoke tails.`
const DOCS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the docs fixer; you own docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/ROADMAP.md and research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json. Round-5 items 2, 3 and 5: fill every "[measured in the re-check]" placeholder in docs/DECISIONS.md (lines about 732, 781, 785) and docs/DESIGN.md (lines about 485, 562) with the measured figures the brief's round-5 list gives (bytes, file counts, event counts, determinism), in the house style with units; correct open item 11's figure to 3,687 cancellation-only groups in the window (3,411 public, 276 fire weather; 446 public groups begin at 00:00 UTC, 2,965 public at other times) wherever the old 3,684 and 3,238 appear (DECISIONS and the verification JSON); add D33's open item (event-number re-use: four named cases; the period rule B5 will implement) to DECISIONS under D35's open items and to the verification record's notes; set the verification record's overall status to reflect round 5 once the site fixer's smoke passes (poll ${OUT}/r5-site/ for a file named smoke_pages_pass.txt every 2 minutes up to 30 minutes; if it never appears, leave the status as fail and say so). Em-dashes 0, no model or AI-vendor names, sentence case. grep afterwards for "[measured in the re-check]" (none may remain) and for 3,684 (none). Report the diff stat.`
const JOINS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the joins fixer; you own website/joins.py and tests/test_joins.py. Round-5 item 4: at website/joins.py line about 1888 the docstring says "110 public groups with a NEW row"; the measured figure is 110 zone groups with a NEW row, 69 public and 41 fire weather, so write that. Also read the _zone_events docstring once more for D30 and D31 consistency (the key includes the office; the known limit names its four cases as the brief's D33 lists them) and fix any sentence that disagrees. No behaviour change. Run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_joins (tail). When done, also write the file ${OUT}/r5-site/joins_done.txt with one line.`
phase('Fix')
const fixes = await parallel([
  () => agent(SITE, { label: 'fix5:site', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }).then((r) => { log('site fixer done'); return r }),
  () => agent(DOCS, { label: 'fix5:docs', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
  () => agent(JOINS, { label: 'fix5:joins', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
])
return { fixes: fixes.map((f) => (f || '').slice(0, 5000)) }

fixes:
Round-5 item 1 is done. The town pages at 288 and 320 px now fit, and smoke_pages, smoke_map and the unit tests all pass on the rebuilt real site.

**Token**
- "Dawson/McCone/Prairie/Richland/Wibaux" (fire weather zone MTZ122). It sits in the zones section's fire lead, "46 red flag warnings for fire weather zone Dawson/McCone/Prairie/Richland/Wibaux Counties (MTZ122) between Oct 17, 2021 and Oct 16, 2026." It also appears in the MTZ122 row of the zone table and in the map sheet's zones fire lead. Glendive (Dawson) and Sidney (Richland) both fall in MTZ122, which is why only those two pages fail.
- Measured in Chromium at 288 px on Glendive: the paragraph's content box is 256 px, the token is about 314 px at 17 px, and the page scroll width is 330 px. The browser has no break point in the token.

**Rule (CSS only, existing classes, words unchanged)**
- `/home/user/wt/wt-b2/website/templates/town.html` line 143: `.joins-sec { margin-top: 20px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` (comment on line 142).
- `/home/user/wt/wt-b2/website/templates/map.html` line 28: `.sheet-body .joins-sec { margin-top: 22px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` (comment on line 27). I read "the sheet" as the map page's sheet, whose join styles live in its hail-only style block. style.css has no join rules, so I left it unchanged.
- No test asserts this CSS, so tests/test_site.py is unchanged.

**Commands and tails**
1. Copy, from /home/user/wt/wt-b2: `tar --exclude=.git -cf - . | (cd /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/src && tar -xf -)`. A diff against the worktree showed no differences except .git and __pycache__.
2. Reproduction build: `cd /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/src && /home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -m website.build --out /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/real --hail-history --sample --hail-store /home/user/hail-b2/out2/joins/hail-store.tar.gz`. Exit 0, 12.8 s.
3. Before: `PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium /home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python tools/smoke_pages.py /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/real`. Exit 1, 43.6 s. Tail: town/glendive.html and town/sidney.html, 42 px wider at 288 px and 10 px wider at 320 px, in light and dark, "no single element named".
4. Edits made with the Edit tool. Read-only check: `git --no-pager diff -- website/templates/town.html website/templates/map.html` shows only the two rules and their comments.
5. Rebuild: copied the two templates into the copy, moved the first build to real-before, same build command. Exit 0, 20.3 s.
6. `tools/smoke_pages.py` on the rebuilt site. Tail: "Page width check passed: every page fits the screen at 288, 320, 375, 768, 1440 px, light and dark." Exit 0, 57.7 s.
7. `tools/smoke_map.py` on the same build. Tail: "Map smoke test passed: page, frames, basemap, bubbles, play, layers, card and the Imagery base map all work, and on a --hail-history build the hail sheet does too (or, without the flag, no sheet is offered); no request went to another site (the imagery tiles aside, after a switch to Imagery)." Exit 0.
8. `/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_site` from the copy. Tail: "Ran 155 tests in 354.127s", "OK", exit 0.

**Side effects, measured by A/B (same build with the two declarations removed)**
- Page widths: glendive and sidney go from 330 to 288 px at 288 px, and from 330 to 320 px at 320 px. The other 15 town pages have no box moved at any of the five widths.
- At 288 px only, the zone table rows on glendive and sidney also wrap now, because the MTZ122 cell holds the same token at 14 px. Before, that table scrolled sideways inside its box. Now it fits, and content below the zones section moves down (Glendive's last join box moves 466 px).
- At 320 px the paragraph breaks without adding a line, so no box moves.
- Map sheet, opened at the Glendive and Sidney centres: at 288 px the sheet body's scroll width goes from 294 to 270, equal to its width, and the fire lead goes from 258 to 238 (its width). Nothing changes at 320, 390 or 1280 px.
- Where the break falls: Glendive at 288 px breaks "Dawson/McCone/Prairie/Richland" and "/Wibaux Counties". The sheet breaks "Wib" and "aux". Screenshots are at /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/diag/fire_after_288.png and /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/diag/sheet_fire_after_288.png.

**Not done or to note**
- No commit, no test change, no docs edits. The docs files differ in the worktree because other fixers changed them. The build does not read them, and the rest of the worktree matches the copy.
- A cleaner break after each slash would need `<wbr>` in the zone names on the Python side. That changes markup, not words, and I did not do it because the brief asked for CSS.
- Files are in /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/: src (copy), real (after), real-before (before), ab-off (A/B), diag/ (scripts and JSON), and the logs build1.log, build2.log, smoke_pages1.log, smoke_pages2.log, smoke_map_after.log and unittest_site.log.

Docs fixer report, round 5 (items 2, 3 and 5). The verification record status is **fail**: the site fixer's `smoke_pages_pass.txt` never appeared in `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/`.

**Smoke poll**
- Polled every 2 minutes from about 04:21 to 04:51 UTC, 16 checks. Last line: `NOT FOUND after 30 minutes (16 checks, last at 04:51:07 UTC)`.
- The site log `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/smoke_pages2.log` shows `EXIT 0`, but no pass file was written, so I did not treat it as a pass.
- Gate B2-7 stays fail; the status and verdict say so.

**Changes, with line numbers**

`/home/user/wt/wt-b2/docs/DECISIONS.md`
- 732: placeholder replaced with measured copy-check figures (partial 2025-06-25 at 717 of 720; 1,586 days checked; 4 re-derived; 239 days with no IEM copy) and B1's compare counts.
- 759: D35 header now covers review decisions D1 to D33.
- 765: warning counts (2,240 SV, 17 TO, 148 FF).
- 769: 3,684 changed to 3,687 groups; pointer to open item 16.
- 770: 1,648 sentence replaced with the 1,116 / 456 / 452 basis.
- 771: station counts (1,261 station days; 3 readings left out).
- 781: budget placeholders replaced with measured sizes.
- 785: determinism at 96 s and 100 s; cold run stays open.
- 795: open item 11 corrected to 3,687 (3,411 public, 276 fire; 446 at 00:00 UTC; 2,965 other times; 298 of the 446 the day after their earliest product, reproduced by my recount). Open item 15 points to D33. New open item (16): the four named cases and the period rule B5 implements.
- The 24 base em-dashes on lines 19 to 809 are replaced with punctuation. No meaning change.

`/home/user/wt/wt-b2/docs/DESIGN.md`
- 1: title dash replaced.
- 209: dash wording replaced.
- 299 to 301: three dash cells replaced with "None".
- 485: tiles list is 4,597 names; 78,152 bytes in `hail/index.json` as written; 64,359 bytes in `data/map.json`.
- 562: budget placeholders replaced with measured sizes.

`/home/user/wt/wt-b2/docs/ROADMAP.md`
- 30, 33: dash cells replaced with "None".
- 39: B2 row. Placeholders filled; status is fail with the reason; open decisions now items 11 to 16.
- 43: "pending" replaced with the round-4 measured status.

`/home/user/wt/wt-b2/research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json`
- `status` fail, `verdict` rewritten, `failed_checks` now lists only the smoke item.
- Gate B2-7 and `gate_summary` stay fail.
- Open items 0, 10, 11, 15, 16, 18 and 22 updated. Item 18 now cites the docstring at line 1891.
- Notes 30, 32 and 34 reworded so the old literals are gone. New note 39 (indices are 0-based) holds the round-5 record.
- `measurements` gains a `round5` block (listings, sums, copy check, compare, recount).

**Commands and tails**
- Tar listing via `tarfile` (read only): `hail/` 9,372 files, 54,227,125 bytes; `j/` 4,598 files, 19,912,416 bytes; `z/` 115 files, 919,402 bytes; `s/` 60 files, 22,478 bytes.
- Tiles list: 78,152 bytes in `hail/index.json`; 64,359 bytes in `data/map.json` (gzip 10,870 to 10,967).
- Site sums: flag on 58,098,447 bytes in 9,466 files; flag off 2,464,186 bytes in 94 files.
- Store counts: 4,960 public and 660 fire zone events in 115 files; 1,261 station days in 60 files.
- `zone_recount.py` (read only, scratch folder): `… 3691 425 … 3687 3411 276 … 446 2965 … 298 | on the same date 0 | before 0`.
- `sweep_dashes.py`: `DECISIONS.md replacements 24 em dashes left 0 / DESIGN.md replacements 5 … 0 / ROADMAP.md replacements 2 … 0`.
- `edit_roadmap_status.py fail`: `ROADMAP line 39 status written: fail`.
- `edit_record.py … fail fixed`: `wrote … status fail notes 40 open_items 23`. Note 40 in that count is list index 39.
- Greps on the four owned files: `[measured in the re-check]` 0 in each; `3,684` 0; `3,238` 0. Across the worktree (outside `research/globe`): none. Em-dashes 0 in the three docs and the JSON.
- JSON layout round-trip: `json layout ok: True`.
- Diff stat, round 5 only (against start-of-round copies in `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/docs-fixer/backup/`): DECISIONS 33 inserted, 33 deleted; DESIGN 7/7; ROADMAP 4/4; record 144 inserted, 20 deleted.
- Cumulative `git diff --stat` against HEAD: 4 files changed, 741 insertions(+), 339 deletions(-). This includes earlier uncommitted rounds.

**Not done or caveats**
- Smoke pass: not present; the site fixer's work is not confirmed.
- Gate B2-4 (units) is still deferred. The cold-cache run is not measured.
- Unit tests, joins verify and compare, the flag-off build and the Chromium smoke were not re-run on the round-5 code; the record says so.
- The compare counts come from `b1-verification.json` (`recheck.compare`), not re-run.
- Round-5 item 4 (joins docstring) was fixed by the joins owner at line 1891 (their note: 144 tests OK). I did not edit `joins.py`.
- Model and vendor names: none added. The existing "ChatGPT" mentions in DECISIONS (11 in base text, including the D23 and D25 headings, which were touched only for the dash) and DESIGN line 65 and ROADMAP lines 8 and 9 are unchanged. The `claude/…` branch identifiers i

Report: joins fixer, round-5 item 4 and the D30/D31 docstring check. No behaviour change.

**Changed**

1. `/home/user/wt/wt-b2/website/joins.py`, `_zone_events` docstring, lines 1877 to 1885:
   - "no event number is shared by two offices" now reads "no event (zone, phenomenon, significance, event number and year) has rows from two offices". The wider claim was false (141 of 198 event-number and year pairs use more than one office), and the verification record asked for the narrower key-level wording.
   - The known-limit sentence now cites DECISIONS D35, open items 15 and 16. It names the four cases in the brief's D33 order, with event numbers and D33's descriptions: MTZ004 WS 2024 event 1, MTZ302 HW 2022 event 38, MTZ320 WS 2023 event 4, MTZ003 WS 2021 event 12.
2. `/home/user/wt/wt-b2/website/joins.py`, lines 1891 to 1892: "the 110 public groups with a NEW row" is now "the 110 zone groups with a NEW row, 69 public and 41 fire weather". The re-measured figures match.
3. `/home/user/wt/wt-b2/tests/test_joins.py`, comment lines 1101 to 1104 only. The old comment gave the key as "zone, office, event number and year" (it omitted phenomenon and significance) and attributed the synthetic MTZ313 test rows to MTZ004. It now gives the full key and says the rows are a synthetic MTZ313 WS 2025 event 31 that follows the MTZ004 pattern.
4. `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/joins_done.txt` written, one line.

**Checks run**

- Cache check: `diff -rq /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache/zones /home/user/hail-b2/out2/recheck4/det/cache/zones` gave no output, so the two caches are identical. I read the recheck4 cache with `/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -I` scripts in `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/joins-r5/`.
- `check_groups.py`: groups with a NEW row are 110 {public 69, fire 41}. Groups with more than one issue time are 21 (17 public, 4 fire), and none of them has a NEW row. The "21 groups" sentence is correct and unchanged.
- `check_offices.py`: event keys without the office that have more than one office = 0. Number and year pairs used by more than one office = 141 of 198.
- `check_status.py`: 6,573 of 6,910 groups have neither NEW nor CON.
- `check_cases.py`: the four D33 cases match the cache (offices MSO, TFX, TFX, MSO).
- `ast.parse` on joins.py: "parses ok".
- `cd /home/user/wt/wt-b2 && /home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_joins`, tail: "Ran 144 tests in 5.923s" / "OK" (exit 0; log at `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/joins-r5/unittest-joins.log`).
- No em-dashes or forbidden names in the edited lines. I ran no git write commands.

**Not done, for the supervisor**

- `website/sources.py` (not mine, not edited): the `nws_zone_products` "Known gaps" text says "four zones in five years" without naming the four cases. The round-3 list gave that row to the joins owner, so it may still need D33 naming.
- The brief's D30 list of update statuses omits EXA. D35, the docstring and sources.py include it, and the cache has 6 EXA rows. I followed D35 and changed nothing.
- The "157 NEW rows ... across all zone types" phrase is unchanged. It matches the record's "across all zone rows (47 non-MTZ)" in substance.
